visual_review.status: completed individual inspection of every original and extracted PNG
findings: All eleven native examples show their authored materials and actual actors in both paused and progressed images. Six new environments have distinct industrial, cave, courtyard, tank and aerial arrangements; no missing texture or broken framebuffer was observed.
Rain Exchange visibly drains the overhead Water tank into a growing lower pool. The older Industrial Yard also shows its Oil and Water falling through ordinary native simulation.

Common Ground shows nearby runners converging. Original copied x positions change from 220 and 340 to 237.5588 and 317.8985 cells; the middle crawler changes from 280 to 276.7584. Fresh extraction is similar. Vertical settling is not counted as exploration.

Original and extracted legacy and living profile editors render inside the actual frame. Apply/Revert and the inspector remain visible. Module catalogue, traits, regions, relationships and scene library/group panes use scroll areas for longer content.
At Overview, inhabitants are small and decorative facades occupy much of the image. Following the selected actor, focusing or zooming is necessary to inspect movement and personality differences.

Actor labels identify rig/model and policy, not personality. Common Ground labels overlap when actors converge; copied intent/home/region labels overlap near the selected actor in the settlement overlay.
All images are actually 1028 x 578 despite the helper initially requesting 1600 x 1000. Text is dense and small at this hosted size. No larger actual capture size is claimed.

New-scene phases cover about two physical simulation seconds but take 20.334-25.113 wall seconds originally and 21.431-25.743 after extraction. Microsoft Basic Render Driver through ANGLE is slow; these images do not qualify smooth physical desktop playfeel.
visual_review.interesting_to_watch_assessment: Short approaches, spacing and moving Water make these coherent places to observe. This exact-source Windows capture gate still covers short episodes; it does not establish sustained interesting lives or repeated group formation/dissolution. An external observer is being prepared to follow selected inhabitants for a real minute without changing the frozen application.
